integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically from the row-count and Davenport-constant ingredients stated in the primary source. The accompanying computation checks representative finite parameters only and is not used as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Prime-power exponents only. The factor count is not claimed globally optimal; the optimality statement is restricted to the harmonic-number sufficient-condition relaxation of the Appendix-A zero-sum parameter scheme. The general-composite branch is not improved.
title: A harmonic sharpening of the affine factorial perfect-power bound
